alpha_ledger.accuracy_columns: null by declaration: this measures a precision lift at a fixed operating rate, not a directional accuracy, and the ledger's bar is denominated in the latter
alpha_ledger.charged_for: the hash-chained count that stops an experiment being quietly unrun

authorization: repository owner, in conversation, 2026-08-19: full authorization to run phase 4a
declaration_note: Rewritten 2026-08-19 after the reseal guard correctly refused a stale hash: the cluster-bootstrap docstring was corrected once measurement showed the interval is tighter than a row bootstrap, not wider, because the lift is a within-session paired contrast. reading any of the five score blocks

known_answer_twin.construction: labels regenerated from a linear direction through the real feature matrix at the real geometry; base rate preserved
known_answer_twin.recovery_rule: recovered iff measured planted lift >= the bar AND its bootstrap lower bound > 0
known_answer_twin.why: job 45 closed underpowered because a gate could not certify an edge the models had demonstrably learned; a preflight that cannot recover its own plant proves nothing about the real features

known_limitations.chain_features_are_band_local: the chain-internal fields are computed on the corpus ladder, which is the near-ATM +/-25-point band (about 20 contracts), not the full 252-280 contract chain. Attribution may not credit the model with information it never saw.
known_limitations.era_probe: the state vector's era detectability was measured at 0.4314 AUC (bar ~0.55) on 2026-08-19
known_limitations.tape_is_close_only: the SPX parity tape is one observation per minute, so open/high/low equal the close and candle anatomy is identically zero; the four channels used here are all functions of the close series

label.definition: reaches +50% before -30% within 60 minutes, on quoted mids
label.economics: NONE READ. The probe sees a binary label and no dollar column.

population.actions: entry-eligible candidates under the signed $2,000 ticket cap and OTM band
population.score_blocks: none may be read; the five score blocks are fit-forbidden
population.sessions: the chronological training prefix only: first 40% of the 1,014 built sessions
population.unlabelled: actions whose label is NaN are excluded from the probe and counted in the receipt

probe.clustering: session-level cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples; the session is the unit of independence

excluded_and_why.account_state: constant at training time by declaration; can carry nothing
excluded_and_why.ladder_context_mean_max: minute-common summaries of the same ladder the per-contract fields come from; including them would breach the parameter ceiling

probe.folds: nested chronological, 5 inner folds inside the prefix; every fold trains strictly earlier than it scores
probe.operating_rate: 2 selections per session (charter amendment 2026-08-16 models two trades a day)
probe.scaling: imputation and standardisation fitted on each fold's training part only

purpose: measure whether the declared feature set carries entry information at all, before spending the 118-parameter fit. A null result from a 25-parameter probe is a statement about the features rather than about optimisation.

verdict_rule.bar_rationale: roughly half the largest entry effect ever measured in this project (+7.1pp) and well under the +14 the target needs
verdict_rule.interval: the LARGER of the Wilson upper bound and the cluster-bootstrap 97.5th percentile -- generous to the features by declaration, so a failure cannot be blamed on the interval
verdict_rule.secondary_probes: any probe other than the declared 25-parameter one is a diagnostic and MAY NOT change the verdict
verdict_rule.statistic: precision at the operating rate minus the base rate on the same scored population

table.outcome: STOP_FEATURES_INSUFFICIENT — publish the negative with a receipt
ADVISORY_UNDERPOWERED — the go/no-go is an owner decision
